text: The Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) National Forest Cartography 2021 identifies the 2021 loss area as a pine plantation. Specifically, it reports 68.1 hectares of planted forest in the event area, with the species listed as *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*. No native forest was detected in the affected zone. This dataset is the source confirming the plantation classification.
